text:
alex: Customer (Acme) opened a case — their tool/function calls are failing with schema validation 400s. Error mentions unexpected additionalProperties 'billing_profile' and type mismatch on session.duration (string vs integer).

acme_integration: This was working yesterday. We started including an optional billing_profile object in the metadata, and now every /v1/invoke returns: 400 ValidationError. We need a quick workaround.

alex: Repro info requested. Can you paste the exact request body + curl? Also need model, route, and whether you hit hosted vs dedicated.

acme_integration: Here (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{
  "tool": "charge_account",
  "args": {
    "user_id": "acct_123",
    "amount": 49.99
  },
  "metadata": {
    "billing_profile": { "plan": "pro", "internal_id": 42 },
    "session": { "id": "sess_abc", "duration": "1h" }
  }
}'
```

server response: 
```json
{ "error": "schema_validation_failed", "details": [ { "path": "/metadata/billing_profile", "error": "additionalProperties not allowed: ['internal_id']" }, { "path": "/metadata/session/duration", "error": "expected integer, got string" } ] }
```

jordan: Thanks. Two separate issues shown: (1) our function schema disallows arbitrary keys under billing_profile (additionalProperties=false) and (2) session.duration is typed as integer (seconds) but client is sending a human string.

lee: Quick mitigation options:
- Strip unknown metadata keys at the gateway for hosted API to prevent hard schema rejects.
- Add a transient coercion layer: accept duration strings like '1h' and convert to seconds if pattern matches.
- Short-term: tell customer to remove billing_profile.internal_id and send duration as integer (seconds).

alex: Customer is asking for immediate fix — they cannot change client right away. Can we do a backward-compatible accept?

anna_sre: If we change validation behavior we need to scope it to the hosted gateway only (no private deployments). Also watch for security/privacy — dropping metadata might hide customer-supplied IDs.

lee: I can push a small gateway transform that: 1) strips additionalProperties under metadata.* (log and attach to request), 2) normalizes session.duration if it matches /^(\\d+)(s|m|h)$/ to seconds. Should be a low-risk patch.

jordan: Please run this as a feature-flagged roll out and add full logging to the trace so we can revert quickly. Also add a validation warning in the response header to notify integrators (X-Redwood-Validation-Warn).

alex: For escalation and tracking — creating ticket RW-4321 and marking P2. Customer wants ETA within 4 hours.

acme_integration: Appreciate it. Any ETA? We have a cron job failing customer billing. :worried:

lee: I'll open a PR for the gateway filter, request review from eng-runtime, and target a staged deploy to prod-canary within 90 minutes. If tests pass, full roll in 3 hours. Will post PR link. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/gateway-transform v2026.03.15-1 -> 2026031510 by lee

lee: Canary looks good (0 errors, traffic sample). Rolling to 20% now.

alex: Customer notified and given temporary mitigation (remove internal_id and send duration as seconds) in the meantime.

jordan: After gateway mitigation, follow-up items: (a) update official function schemas to mark billing_profile as allow additionalProperties or document allowed keys, (b) add explicit schema coercion docs for session.duration, (c) add an eval to catch regressions in toolcall validation.

acme_integration: Confirmed tests on our side show invoke now succeeding after you rolled the canary transform. Thank you!

alex: Closing loop; leaving RW-4321 open for the schema + docs follow-up.

lee: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1184 (gateway transform + flag) — will keep the thread updated for full rollout.
